name: Network Scanner
description:
Multi-method LAN scanner (nmap ping, arp-scan, service detection, ARP cache).
Requirements (already satisfied in this image/compose file): docker-compose.yml must set network_mode: host and cap_add: [NET_RAW, NET_ADMIN] - otherwise this only sees Docker's internal bridge network and can't resolve fresh MAC addresses (only what's already in the ARP cache). nmap and arp-scan must be installed (they are, via tools/Dockerfile).
Subnet must be in CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.102.0/24 - a bare IP like 192.168.102.1 only scans that one host, not the whole range.
Each run updates the persistent device inventory (/app/data/network_inventory.json) - use Label Device to name devices and View Inventory to browse it.

parameters.name: subnet
parameters.description: Subnet to scan in CIDR notation, e.g. 192.168.102.0/24

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Show which method(s) detected each device

parameters.name: export_csv
parameters.description: Also save results as CSV under /app/data/network_scans
